article-guide.definition: An article, tutorial, changelog post, or how-to guide.
article-guide.label: Article / Guide

dataset.definition: A dataset for training, evaluation, or benchmarking.
dataset.label: Dataset

directory-gallery.definition: A curated directory, gallery, or collection of resources.
directory-gallery.label: Directory / Gallery

documentation.definition: Reference documentation or a docs site.
documentation.label: Documentation

library-framework.definition: A reusable code library, UI kit, or application framework.
library-framework.label: Library / Framework

other.definition: A resource that does not fit any type above.
other.label: Other

provider.definition: An inference or API provider, or a comparison of providers.
provider.label: Provider

repository.definition: A source-code repository, usually hosted on GitHub.
repository.label: Repository

service-platform.definition: A hosted service or platform (SaaS/PaaS) the user signs up for.
service-platform.label: Service / Platform

template-starter.definition: A project template, starter kit, or boilerplate.
template-starter.label: Template / Starter

tool.definition: A standalone application or utility that performs a task for the user.
tool.label: Tool
